sloka: सो अपश्यमः ताम् महा बाहुः पश्यमः च अन्या वर स्त्रियः ।विषसाद महा बाहुर् हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः ॥५-१२-२३॥
transliteration: so apaśyamaḥ tām mahā bāhuḥ paśyamaḥ ca anyā vara striyaḥ ।viṣasāda mahā bāhur hanūmān māruta ātmajaḥ ॥5-12-23॥

translations.english: The longarmed Hanuman, son of the Windgod was able to see other great women but not Sita. So he became despondent.
